def transform(grid):
    """Recover the rectangular zeroed-out patch by 180-degree symmetry."""
    missing = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in missing)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in missing)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in missing)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in missing)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
